_about: One line of truth per PR for out/index.html. Each headline must be backed by an executed receipt named in `evidence`.

2234.headline: Fixes an analyzer crash on duplicate keys, not the reported #2234 regression (not in this history); 6 of the agent's 10 tests prove nothing.

2297.headline: Does what #2297 asks on net8.0, but breaks the build (CS0579) for users who already excluded their resolver, and skips netstandard2.0 for a false reason.

2283.headline: Fixes the crash, and adds an unrequested global filter that silently deletes real MsgPack004 errors: proven by re-running the PR head with only the filter reverted.
evidence: agent test UnkeyedMember fails without the filter

2129.headline: A 28-file feature (new analyzers MsgPack019-022). The attention budget clears only 2 files: on hand-written features, machine clearing doesn't help, so this one needs a real human review.
